ASSISTANT: Your transfer is done. $100.00 USD was sent from your checking account to Alice. Transfer ID: transfer-001, status: completed. Is there anything else I can help you with?
CUSTOMER: The app showed a timeout and I do not know whether it went through. Please retry the $100.00 transfer to Alice.
ASSISTANT: Good news: your original transfer went through, so I have not sent it again. Our records show $100.00 USD from your checking account to Alice, Transfer ID transfer-001, status: completed. The timeout in the app doesn't appear to have affected it. Retrying would send Alice a second $100.00. If you do want to send an additional $100.00, just confirm and I'll set it up.
